question: My parcel arrived two days late. Do I get any money back?
response: Sorry for the delay. Late parcels can qualify for a partial refund of the delivery fee.
reference: Yes. Wrenfield refunds part of the delivery fee for each working day late, up to half the fee.

question: When will my refund reach my card?
response: Refunds usually take about a week.
reference: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 working days of approval.

question: A pallet we shipped arrived damaged. How do we claim?
response: Please open a damage claim in the Wrenfield app and attach photos.
reference: Open a damage claim in the Wrenfield app within 14 days, with photos of the goods and the packaging.

question: How are refunds paid on a business account?
response: Business refunds are credited to your account.
reference: On business accounts, refunds are credited against the next monthly invoice.

question: My parcel never arrived. What happens now?
response: Sorry to hear that. Please report the parcel missing and we will search for it.
reference: Report the parcel missing in the app; if the search fails, Wrenfield refunds its value and the delivery fee.

question: We cancelled tomorrow's collection. Is the fee refunded?
reference: Collections cancelled before 6 pm the day before are refunded in full.

question: Mi paquete llegó con dos días de retraso. ¿Me devuelven algo?
response: Lamentamos el retraso. Los paquetes con retraso pueden tener derecho a un reembolso parcial de la tarifa de envío.
reference: Sí. Wrenfield reembolsa parte de la tarifa de envío por cada día laborable de retraso, hasta la mitad de la tarifa.

question: ¿Cuándo llegará el reembolso a mi tarjeta?
response: Los reembolsos suelen tardar una semana.
reference: Los reembolsos vuelven al método de pago original en un plazo de 5 días laborables desde la aprobación.

question: ¿Cómo se pagan los reembolsos en una cuenta de empresa?
response: En las cuentas de empresa, los reembolsos se abonan en la cuenta.
reference: En las cuentas de empresa, los reembolsos se abonan en la siguiente factura mensual.

question: A minha encomenda chegou com dois dias de atraso. Recebo algum reembolso?
response: Lamentamos o atraso. As encomendas atrasadas podem ter direito a um reembolso parcial da taxa de envio.
reference: Sim. A Wrenfield reembolsa parte da taxa de envio por cada dia útil de atraso, até metade da taxa.

question: Quando é que o reembolso chega ao meu cartão?
response: Os reembolsos costumam demorar cerca de uma semana.
reference: Os reembolsos voltam ao método de pagamento original no prazo de 5 dias úteis após a aprovação.

question: Como são pagos os reembolsos numa conta empresarial?
response: Nas contas empresariais, os reembolsos são creditados na conta.
reference: Nas contas empresariais, os reembolsos são creditados na fatura mensal seguinte.
